propositions: A plan edited mid-review continues consuming LLM passes and only fails at sign time due to material mismatch, causing wasted billing after the edit point
Checkpoint keys are based on material fingerprint; edits invalidate all Pass-1 checkpoints, making completed work unreusable
The cancel mechanism must scope to own material only (not relation snapshot or related material) to avoid false cancellations on unrelated ticket writes
Probe placement at pass seams (after finders and after decide) with early return in _chunk prevents recovery reconstructions and sidecar emission
A cancelled verdict is unsigned INDETERMINATE with finding id plan-review-cancelled-stale and exits with code 2, never reaching sign or sidecar
The cancel token uses ContextVar and threading.Event to reach pool workers via copy_context, with fail-open behavior if fingerprint read returns None
